source: Trimmed from the 2026-09-25 dynasty research prospects.json (scratchpad/dynasty/prospect_curve.js): pMake = P(200 NHL GP) or a 40-start goalie season, from NHL GP so far / NHLe translation / draft slot, with a capped scouting (tier) logit shift; fpgIfMake = prime FP/G at 25 on the realized scale; eta = first regular season if he makes it. comp = prior components (draft slot, NHLe, scouting tier) for the young-player convergence. Numbers only; no scouting text. | nhle-v2: drafted skaters under 100 NHL GP and 25 refreshed or added by scripts/dynasty-fit-prospects.ts (src/data/dynasty/prospect-model.json). Their pMake carries no scouting-tier shift (dropped 2026-10-02: it cannot be rebuilt at a past date, so it was never backtested); comp keeps the earlier research's components, which the engine does not read.
scoring: FP = 3G + 2.4A1 + 1.6A2 + 0.4SOG + 0.3HIT (+0.3BLK +0.35TK for D); goalies 3W -1.5GA +0.27SV +3SO +1OTL -1OSW(0.221*W est.). OT points, hat tricks, skater SO omitted (~+1-2%).
